description: List forms from the Form.io project mapped to the user's current working directory with optional filtering and pagination.

cwd.description: User's current working directory as an absolute path. Selects the Form.io project that directory resolves to, by scope, narrowest first: a committed formio.json found by walking up from it, then the working-directory mapping project_set writes, then FORMIO_PROJECT_URL in the environment, which is the weakest of the three. Pass it on EVERY call whenever you know it: omitting it resolves against the MCP server's own working directory, which is fixed at spawn and may resolve to a different project. No environment variable removes the need for it — the environment is the source a file or a mapping overrides, not the one that overrides them.

limit.description: Maximum number of forms to return (default: 20)

skip.description: Number of forms to skip for pagination

name: form_list

count.description: Number of forms returned by this call

forms.description: Matching forms, in the requested sort order

access.description: Role-based access to the form definition itself

components.description: Component tree defining the fields, layout, and logic of the form

machineName.description: Machine-readable unique name within the project

owner.description: ID of the submission owner, when set

path.description: URL path the form is served at, relative to the project

project.description: ID of the project owning the form

revisions.description: Revision mode: "original", "current", or false when disabled

submissionAccess.description: Role-based access to the submissions of this form

type.description: "form" for a form, "resource" for a data resource
